Going Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat into Rider pairing was unforgettable to this attendee [4]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): A hard-rocking version, the one thing singled out by this reviewer [14]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Named a highlight of the show [13]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): The stretch from Tennessee Jed through Eyes of the World felt otherworldly to this attendee [4]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Named a highlight, with Donna singing on it [13]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The Dark Star into Eyes into Half Step run is a standout of the show [3]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The Not Fade Away sandwich around Going Down the Road is also judged good [3]

## The recordings

- **gd73-02-26.sbd.kaplan.1208.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 183 min; rated 3.67/5 by 21 [1]. Said about its sound: Disc 3, track 2 (Eyes) has a splice at 3:25 [1]
- **gd1973-02-26.167612.sbd.roman.revision.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 182 min [2]. Said about its sound: Almost two minutes of tuning remained after El Paso, and another minute after Big Railroad Blues [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first show; the Wall of Sound was so loud it was frightening, and the first chord seemed likely to blow everyone out [4]
- Overall the show is judged weaker than many other February 1973 shows, though still worth a listen [3]
- Playing is spirited and very good, but many shows from 1973 are better [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-02-26.sbd.kaplan.1208.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The Dick's Picks 28 release lacks some songs that this complete version of the show contains; Source chain: soundboard master to cassette, then DAT, CDR, EAC extraction and SHN files; Seth Kaplan did the EAC/SHN encoding; Greg Hamilton uploaded it [1][6]
- **gd1973-02-26.167612.sbd.roman.revision.flac1644**: transferred by Revised by Roman; source: Revised version of Seth Kaplan source S:MR > cassette > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN [2]. Also: This show is featured on Dick's Picks 28; this revision only adjusts flow, with no change to sound or music; The cassette copy had pauses inserted between non-segued tracks, apparently to save space, and they vary randomly in length [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.wulfware.de: [GD730226](http://www.wulfware.de/covers/Index3/GD730226.htm) [16]
